proposed_widenings.name: grant_movement_through_openings
proposed_widenings.justification: The inherited Gaseous Form effect grants a persistent movement capability that is not speed, teleportation, or forced movement.
proposed_widenings.evidence: the target can move through a space as small as 1 inch wide without squeezing

proposed_widenings.name: EffectAtom.restrict_action_set
proposed_widenings.justification: The surface has no standalone effect atom for an ongoing prohibition on attacking/casting; action restriction currently exists only inside grant_extra_action, which would be a false encoding here.
proposed_widenings.evidence: The target can't attack or cast spells.

proposed_widenings.name: DurationEndTrigger.target_ends_effect_as_bonus_action
proposed_widenings.justification: Timed effects can end on passive triggers today, but not on a voluntary self-dismiss that spends action economy.
proposed_widenings.evidence: or until you end the effect as a Bonus Action

notes: The item fits MagicItemRecord with activation/timed/single-use structure, but the delegated Gaseous Form effect cannot be authored honestly with the current atom surface. No content .dhall/.json/.trace was written.
